d1: Bawli, juniors ke samne chaud mat bigaad, yahan sher banna padta hai, ghar toh tera ghulaam hoon!
Bawli, suitcase hai ya bori? Itna achaar bhar diya, ab posting pe main jaunga ya ye laddo?
Bawli, maine 'PT' bola tha, 'Peti' nahi! Is parade ke shor ne tera dimaag hi ghuma diya!
Bawli, mooch dekh ke jal mat, vardi mein tera yo fauji tere saare hero te suthra laage!
Bawli, boori dhote waqt tera khat mil gaya, ab thakaan kahan, ab toh bas muskurahat bachi hai!
